_comment: Copy this file to config.json and edit. Every key is optional; these are the defaults.
_categories: Any of: Software, AI/ML/Data, Quant, Hardware, Product
_degrees: Keep postings that accept any of these (only Simplify says; other sources are kept). Any of: Bachelor's, Master's, PhD, MBA, Associate's
_class_years: Graduation years you can present yourself as. The first one is the default filter.
_needs_sponsorship: true if you are an international student (F-1/J-1/OPT). Flags defense contractors, national labs and federal bodies as long shots and hides them by default.
_sources: Where postings come from. Remove a line to drop a source; add board slugs for any employer on Greenhouse/Lever/Ashby (the slug is the word after the company in its job-board URL). Append =Display Name to override how a board is labelled.
_source: Simplify's listings file for your season. For another season, use that repo's .github/scripts/listings.json on its dev branch.
_expose: Who can reach the local site. local = this computer only. tailscale = this computer + your own devices over Tailscale (what the phone widget needs). lan = every device on your network (not recommended on campus wifi).
_site_url: What the phone widget opens when tapped. Leave empty to use the Tailscale address automatically.
_you: Optional first name, shown in the page subtitle.
